description: This file defines the EncounterType class, representing different types of encounters within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes properties like encounterTypeId, viewPrivilege, and editPrivilege, along with constructors and accessor methods, and is annotated for auditing.

classes.name: EncounterType
classes.description: Represents a specific type of medical encounter, including access privileges and metadata.

methods.name: getEncounterTypeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this encounter type.

methods.name: setEncounterTypeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this encounter type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the getId method to return encounterTypeId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the setId method to set encounterTypeId.

methods.name: getViewPrivilege
methods.description: Returns the privilege required to view this encounter type.

methods.name: setViewPrivilege
methods.description: Sets the privilege required to view this encounter type.

methods.name: getEditPrivilege
methods.description: Returns the privilege required to edit this encounter type.

methods.name: setEditPrivilege
methods.description: Sets the privilege required to edit this encounter type.
